name: Rehal
summary: An open Quran rests on a simple folding stand. Ivory pages and warm copper wood create a calm, grounded mark.
why: The straight page edges and visible center fold make the book readable. Two broad crossing boards place it on a rehal, connecting the identity to Quran recitation and daily devotion. The sparse geometry stays clear when reduced.
risk: It emphasizes Quran reading; the app name carries the wider prayer-time purpose. At very small sizes it simplifies to a book on a stand.
reasonToChoose: Quran reading and devotion should be the strongest association.
